mainText: Good morning. Futures are pointing lower this Friday. The Dow is about flat, up a tenth of a percent. The S and P 500 is down half a percent, and the Nasdaq 100 is down one point four percent, as the tech selloff continues. The S and P is coming off six straight down days. The 10 year Treasury yield is about four point nine nine percent, down about six basis points from yesterday's close, as investors seek safety. Biggest premarket movers: Intuit is down eleven percent after cutting full-year revenue guidance. Anthropic is down six and a half percent on profit-taking after its record IPO debut. A M D is down five and a half percent, SanDisk down about six percent, Micron down three point nine percent, and Nvidia down two point seven percent. Walmart is up one point nine percent after raising guidance for fiscal 2027 on strong third-quarter results.
